method: Independent test cases exercising the current pure classifier; no builder execution and no PDF generation

checks.label: All missing questions have a form destination
Actual complete bundle accepted, including false certificate request
Provided does not mean transferred or ready for filing
Participant certificate request never becomes court decision
Five-count fixture requires exactly five offence classes

missing.question: What sentence did the court impose?
missing.formDestination: Form 31(a) Section V, item 1 (Other Information for the Court), or a clearly labeled attached continuation if the answer does not fit.
missing.participantNextAction: Answer: What sentence did the court impose?

missing.question: What is the class of each conviction listed in Section I?
missing.formDestination: Add the class beside its matching conviction in Form 31(a) Section I; use the Section I count continuation immediately after Form 31(a) when needed.
missing.participantNextAction: Answer: What is the class of each conviction listed in Section I?

missing.question: Have all probation or sentence conditions been fulfilled, have you been discharged, and on what date?
missing.formDestination: Answer the printed Form 31(a) Section II compliance choices and put the completion/discharge date in Form 31(a) Section V, item 1, or on a clearly labeled attached continuation.
missing.participantNextAction: Answer: Have all probation or sentence conditions been fulfilled, have you been discharged, and on what date?

missing.question: Do you request a certificate of second chance with this application?
missing.formDestination: State Yes or No in Form 31(a) Section V, item 1, or on a clearly labeled attached continuation. Do not mark any Form 31(b) certificate finding or grant/deny box.
missing.participantNextAction: Answer: Do you request a certificate of second chance with this application?
